description: Hi,We are Terra Bytes, participants in the Nasa Space Apps Challenge.We are a young duo interested in science, technology and understanding the world around us. Our project explores the Urban Heat Island effect in Gauteng using NASA POWER data. We chose Gauteng because, as a beginners, we wanted to start with a familiar environment before exploring global climate trends. We're excited to learn, challenge ourselves and discover how data and technology can help us understand environmental issues.
